what_happened: After the policy took over, the ego braked hard on an open highway, from 15.7 to 6.8 m/s, even though the nearest vehicle ahead was more than 40 m away. It fell about 20 m behind the recorded position, and following car 28 caught up and overlapped the ego from behind and the right. The event was scored as a front collision, but it was really a rear-end caused by braking for nothing.
